about:
MBS Custom Woodworking Corp. established its headquarters in West Haven, Connecticut, in 2009 under owner Bogdan Sarzynski. The company began with a focus on transforming interior and exterior spaces through custom woodworking, serving clients primarily across the tri-state area of New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut.

The shop designs, builds, and installs custom cabinetry and millwork for residential, commercial, and public projects. Its capabilities span kitchens, bathrooms, offices, bars, libraries, closets, entertainment units, doors, crown moulding, paneling, stairs, custom furniture, and furniture refinishing, as well as pergolas and windows. The team also produces professional AutoCAD shop drawings for each project. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

MBS serves homeowners, businesses, and institutional clients throughout the tri-state region. Past work includes private residences, commercial offices, and public spaces, though specific client names are not published.

The company emphasizes that no project is too large or too small, offering full-service support from initial consultation through final execution. Its stated goal is to deliver beautiful results that enhance life and well-being.
